A thieves' guild has formed beneath Thais. Join it through {npc:Dorian} and carry out 8 missions across the continent: hunt ivory, rob a shop in Carlin, bribe for invitations, sell a bridge that isn't yours disguised as a dwarf, kidnap a goldfish, blackmail a guard and leave a message in the Dark Cathedral. At the end you can trade with {npc:Black Bert} and choose a special weapon.
An underground guild has formed beneath Thais. Join it by talking to Dorian and learn some of its tricks.
No minimum level; level 70+ recommended (especially for mission 8, in the Dark Cathedral).
For the alternative method of mission 6: **Archpostman** rank in the Postman Guild and a {item:Post Officers Hat}.
from Elephants (you can collect them before you start)
buy 3 to 10 from Dorian in mission 2
2,000 gp (1,000 for Oswald and 1,000 for Ahmet)
6,000 gp (1,000 for Herbert and 5,000 for the Precious Necklace) **or** Archpostman rank + {item:Post Officers Hat}
A weapon of your choice: {item:Modified Crossbow}, {item:Spellbook of Warding} or {item:Assassin Dagger}
When you report the last mission (8, Message) to {npc:Dorian}; Black Bert is upstairs.
Collect the 10 {item:Tusk|Tusks} from {creature:Elephant|Elephants} (at Port Hope) before you start: you save a trip.
In mission 4 **do not use** the {item:Disguise Kit (Dwarf)} until you are next to {npc:Nurik}: the disguise only lasts 5 minutes.
Every time you return to Dorian, say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} to hand in the mission; then {key:mission} again to receive the next one.

In **Thais**, go beneath the docks, east of the boat. {npc:Dorian} is a few squares west of {npc:Gamel}. Say {key:hi}, {key:thieves} and {key:yes} to join the guild. Then say {key:mission}: the first job is to collect 10 elephant tusks.
Kill {creature:Elephant|Elephants} (in Tiquanda, near Port Hope) until you have **10** {item:Tusk|Tusks}.
Getting the mission and buying lock picks

Tell {npc:Dorian} {key:mission}: you have to steal a vase from {npc:Sarina}, owner of the equipment shop in Carlin. Say {key:trade} and buy {item:Lock Pick|Lock Picks} (3 to 10 recommended, because they can break).
Travel to **Carlin** and go to {npc:Sarina}'s shop. Use the **vines** on the side wall of the house to reach the locked room.
The vines on Sarina's house and the vase chest
Use the {item:Lock Pick|Lock Picks} on the chest until it opens and take the {item:Valuable vase|vase}.
Tell {npc:Dorian} {key:mission}: he wants an invitation to the king's ball, and the one who gives them out is {npc:Oswald}.
Go and see {npc:Oswald}, east of the Thais temple. Say {key:hi}, {key:invitation}, {key:gold}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. You pay **1,000 gp** and receive the {item:Invitation}.
The plan: you disguise yourself as a dwarven ambassador and sell the old dwarven bridge, south of Kazordoon, to a foolish merchant from Venore. You need forged documents and a disguise.

Go to the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}, east of Thais and west of Venore, next to the Plains of Havoc ({coord:32643,32222,7}). {npc:Snake Eye} is in the tavern, on the underground floor of the village's main building. Talk to him. Say {key:hi} and {key:documents}: he sends you to {npc:Ahmet}, in Ankrahmun.
Go to **Ankrahmun**, north of the depot (1 floor up), and tell {npc:Ahmet} {key:hi} and {key:documents}. Sometimes he sells them to you straight away; other times he first asks you to kill a nomad.
Go to the oasis **north of Ankrahmun** and kill at least one {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomad}.
Go back to {npc:Ahmet} and say {key:hi}, {key:documents}, {key:yes}. You pay **1,000 gp** and receive the {item:Deed of Ownership}.
Go to **Carlin**. {npc:Percybald} is usually east of the temple, near the east gate. Say {key:hi} and {key:disguise}: he sends you to fetch a copy of the script.
Go to the theatre (east of the Carlin temple) and, in the basement prop room, grab a copy of the {item:Theatre Script}. Read it: you will need the lines.

Go back to {npc:Percybald} and say {key:hi}, {key:test}, {key:yes}. He says a line from the script and you have to reply with the **next** line. After each correct answer say {key:yes}. The lines may vary; these are the known ones:
**Do not use the disguise kit yet!** The disguise only lasts 5 minutes.

Go to **Venore** and find {npc:Nurik} beneath the depot, on the **east** side, on floor -1. Next to him, use the {item:Disguise Kit (Dwarf)} (you have 5 minutes). Say {key:hi}, {key:dwarven bridge} and {key:yes} four times. He swaps the {item:Deed of Ownership} for {item:The Famous Mina Losa Painting}.
Tell {npc:Dorian} {key:mission}: the smugglers in a hidden cave north of Port Hope have a valuable goblet.
Go to the smugglers' cave, **northwest of Port Hope**, and go down.
There are {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} on the way.

On floor -1, go down the stairs to the **northeast**. Keep going until you can turn **south**, follow that path and go down the stairs. Down there is a quest door with a chest: open it and take the {item:Stolen Golden Goblet}.
The chest with the Stolen Golden Goblet
Mission 5: route in the smugglers' cave

With the goblet, go back the same way: climb the same stairs to floor -1 and from there to the surface, northwest of Port Hope. Then return to Thais by boat (at the Port Hope harbour: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
You have to kidnap Theodore Loveless's goldfish, in Liberty Bay. The lock is too good for lock picks, so you need the key. There are two methods.
Go to the jewellery shop in the **northeast** corner of Liberty Bay and say {key:hi} and {key:key} to {npc:Chantalle}. She refuses, but says the postman {npc:Herbert} is easy to bribe.
Go to the Liberty Bay depot and say {key:hi}, {key:letter}, {key:gold}, {key:yes} to {npc:Herbert}. You pay **1,000 gp** and receive the {item:Letter to Chantalle}.
Method 1 — buying the necklace from Carina
Go to **Venore** and talk to {npc:Carina} (bank, east depot). Say {key:hi}, {key:precious necklace}, {key:yes}: you pay **5,000 gp** for the {item:Precious Necklace}.
Method 1 — swapping the necklace for the key
Go back to Liberty Bay and say {key:hi} and {key:key} to {npc:Chantalle}. She gives you the {item:Theodore Loveless' Key}.

If you have the **Archpostman** rank, put the {item:Post Officers Hat} on your head and ask for the key with {key:hi} and {key:key}: to {npc:Bertram} if your character is **female**, or to {npc:Chantalle} if it is **male**. They compliment your uniform and give you the {item:Theodore Loveless' Key}.
With the key, go up to the floor above Chantalle's jewellery shop and open the door. Inside, **use** the {item:Goldfish Bowl (Object)}: a {item:Fishnapped Goldfish} appears in your backpack.
Mission 6: the fish bowl on the floor above the jewellery shop
Tell {npc:Dorian} {key:mission}: he wants something compromising about one of Venore's guards.

Go to the **Venore** guards' barracks (the first street you pass when heading east from the southwest gate). Go up **two floors** and **use** the {item:Chest of Drawers (Quest)} in the room to get the {item:Compromising Letter}.
Room with the chest of drawers (2 floors up)
Mission 7: the chest of drawers in the Venore barracks
Go back to {npc:Dorian}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He promises access to the black market after the next mission.
Tell {npc:Dorian} {key:mission}: you have to put a guild message on the wall between the two trophies, on the lowest level of the rival base beneath the Dark Cathedral (Plains of Havoc).

The {wiki:Dark Cathedral} is **west** of the Plains of Havoc, **south** of the Outlaw Camp and the Venore swamp ({coord:32664,32344,7}); you can only get there by crossing the plains. The first two underground floors are reached by stairs: go down to the **2nd floor** and, from the stairs, head **south** to a large room with the teleport at the far end.
In the middle of the Plains of Havoc there may be {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} attracted by other players.
Go down to the **second underground floor** of the {wiki:Dark Cathedral}. Pull the **six levers** of the circle (they are at the blue dots in the image).

After pulling the first one, run: the levers go back after about 1 minute. Watch out for {creature:Assassin|Assassins}, {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Hunter|Hunters}.
With all six levers active, the {item:Teleport|teleport} in the middle of the floor becomes active. Step into it.
Putting the note on the wall

On the 3rd floor, walk **north** and **use** the {item:Note from the Thieves Guild|note} between the two demon trophies on the wall (the white circle in the images marks the right spot). Then go back the same way to the 2nd floor and climb the same stairs to the surface. To return to Thais, head **north** to Venore and take a boat ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
The spot between the trophies where the note goes (white circle)
If you are in a team, the note can take a while to reset after being placed.
Handing in the mission and choosing the reward

Go back to {npc:Dorian}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. From now on you can trade with {npc:Black Bert}, on the floor above. Enter the room next to Dorian (on the left) and choose **one** item: {item:Modified Crossbow}, {item:Spellbook of Warding} or {item:Assassin Dagger}.
The reward room next to Dorian
Modified Crossbow, Spellbook of Warding or Assassin Dagger (only one) + access to Black Bert
Before 23 October (update 9.7) the Compromising Letter from mission 7 was hidden under a bed's pillow; it was changed because the update broke the quests that used beds.
